snip.t: Chronic traumatic encephalopathy (CTE) occurs with repeated head trauma.

| Chronic Traumatic Encephalopathy (CTE) | After repeated head trauma; formerly "dementia pugilistica"; brain atrophy, enlarged ventricles, tau-containing neurofibrillary tangles in gyral depths and perivascular regions of frontal and temporal cortices |
